summary: Maker CSV Review Import (iter183) — backend + frontend verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 3/3 PASS (test_review_csv_import.py: full lifecycle, missing-cols 422, auth 401). Frontend Playwright: ReviewImportCard renders on /maker/dashboard?tab=reviews, expands via review-import-toggle, all 7 required testids present (source-etsy/shopify/csv, public-toggle, dropzone, file-input, submit). Uploaded fresh unique CSV (2 rows w/ uuid) → result panel shows 'Imported 2 reviews'; past-imports history lists 3 batches each with toggle-public + delete buttons. Public maker page /makers/williams-cnc shows 2 'from etsy' review-imported-badge-* badges. Dashboard reviews list shows 2 review-source-badge-* badges. ReviewImportCard is correctly positioned above the Stats KPIs (Total Reviews / Avg Rating). All success criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: maker_review_imports.py: dedupe pre-loads up to 50,000 hashes per maker into memory each upload — fine today but consider hashing as a Mongo unique-ish index (maker_slug + dedupe_hash) and using insertMany ordered=false to let the DB reject duplicates if a maker ever crosses ~10k reviews.

_parse_rating greedily strips any non-digit, so input '15' yields 5 after clamp (15 → max 1, min 5 → 5), not 1. Acceptable since 15 is invalid anyway, but worth noting that '10' will silently become 1 (first digit). Consider parsing the full integer (re.search(r'\d+', s)) before clamp to be predictable.
csv reader trusts UploadFile content but doesn't verify content-type or sniff for binary — fine because _MAX_BYTES + utf-8 decode short-circuit early.
Frontend ReviewImportCard: file accept='.csv,text/csv' is correct; drag-drop handler uses dataTransfer.files[0] without checking length, but handleFile guards with .csv regex.
Past-imports list paginates only to 200 rows server-side — fine for any plausible maker but worth surfacing if usage grows.
ReviewsTab source-badge testid uses review-source-badge-{reviewId} which only renders when source truthy — matches spec; native reviews correctly skipped.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all required testids + uploaded CSV inserted live)

seed_data_creation: Uploaded one fresh CSV under williams-cnc with 2 unique rows (uuid-suffixed sarah_b_* and Tony R. * reviewers). DB now contains 3 review_import_batches for williams-cnc + 2 net new reviews. Not cleaned up so main agent can inspect.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_review_csv_import.py — re-runnable, regenerates a fresh batch each lifecycle run and cleans up. DB currently has 3 leftover batches under williams-cnc from this iteration's frontend run + earlier lifecycle runs (2 of them have inserted=0 because the original CSV body matched the lifecycle test's content — that's expected dedupe behavior, not a bug). Two 500-status console errors observed during navigation appeared unrelated to import flow (likely separate dashboard widget) and did not block any tested functionality.
